title: Drumee instance configuration
description: Single source of truth for a Drumee deployment. Rendered by config/render.mjs into a container .env, a docker-compose.yml, and a native debconf preseed (install.conf).

domain.description: Primary domain. Use 'local' for a non-Internet-reachable install.

local_mode.description: True for local-only (not reachable from the public Internet).

admin_email.description: Administrator login identifier and notification address.

ip4.description: Public IPv4, or 'auto' to detect at install time.

ip6.description: Public IPv6, or 'auto' to detect at install time.

mode.description: acme = auto-issue via ZeroSSL/Let's Encrypt; own = bring your own wildcard certs; self-signed = local dev.

acme_email.description: Required when mode=acme. Account email for the ACME provider.

own_cert_path.description: Required when mode=own. Path to wildcard certs for the domain.

backup_location.description: Backup target; should be a different partition. May be a remote rsync target.

host.description: DB host. 'mariadb' (compose service) for containers, 'localhost' for native.

password.description: App user password. Null = generate. The user is granted broad privileges (the app creates per-hub/drumate DBs at runtime).

root_password.description: MariaDB root/admin password used by schemas-init to create DBs + grant the app user. Null = generate.

password.description: Null = generate a strong random password at render time.

email.description: Outbound SMTP for notifications and the welcome email.

optional_services.description: Heavy/optional services. In the container channel these map to docker-compose profiles.

ports.description: Internal listener ports the reverse proxy targets. Must match the app's yp.sys_conf listeners.

versions.description: Component versions / image tags. Drives both the compose image tags and the native package set.

images.description: Container image source. Set registry to where publish-images.sh pushed (e.g. ghcr.io/drumee).

registry.description: Image namespace/registry prefix for the drumee/* images.

plugins.description: Optional Drumee plugins to ship with the instance. Each name maps to image <registry>/<name>:<plugins tag> and is loaded for the 'main' endpoint. Server plugins add backend services (acl+service+schema); UI plugins add dynamically-loaded frontend bundles.

server.description: Server plugin names, e.g. [loby]. Each adds backend services; its schema is loaded into the hub template + existing entity DBs and it is registered in conf.d/plugins/<endpoint>.json.

ui.description: UI plugin names, e.g. [signin, signup]. Each publishes a webpack bundle the proxy serves at /-/plugins/<name>/, resolved at runtime by bootstrap.plugin.

tag.description: Image tag for plugin images (separate from core component versions).
